description: Zurich’s comprehensive protection solutions designed to safeguard your valuable assets whether commercial, industrial, or residential against unexpected perils. The products are categorized into two main frameworks:PSAKI: A Named Perils policy covering specific risks under FLEXAS (Fire, Lightning, Explosion, Impact of Falling Aircraft, and Smoke). PAR/IAR: An Un-named Perils (All Risks) policy that covers any sudden physical loss or damage, except for explicitly stated exclusions (such as war, nuclear radiation, willful negligence, or faulty workmanship)
target_client: Personal Property Owners, Commercial & Business Entities, Industrial Sectors
key_deliverables: 1. Comprehensive Asset Protection: Financial compensation for damages inflicted upon buildings, machinery, equipment, furniture, and trading stocks (raw, in-process, or finished goods).2. Tailored Policy Extensions: Optional add-ons for social perils (RSMDCC - Riots, Strike, Malicious Damage & Civil Commotion), atmospheric disturbances (typhoon, storm, flood), and catastrophic seismic events (EQVET - Earthquake, Tsunami, and Volcanic Eruption). 3. Financial Restoration (Indemnity/Reinstatement): Efficient reinstatement or cash payout to return the insured to their exact pre-loss financial position.

service_name: Zurich Contractor's All Risks (CAR) & Fit-Out Products
description: Comprehensive insurance designed to protect non-structural indoor renovation/fit-out projects and large-scale structural civil engineering works. It covers material damage to the contract works, construction plant/machinery, and third-party liability claims (bodily injury or property damage) arising during the project lifecycle.
target_client: Contractors, sub-contractors, project owners (principals), and financing firms/banks. Projects include offices, mall stores, apartments, residential homes, factories, and civil infrastructures.
key_deliverables: * Comprehensive financial protection against project losses, theft, fire, or natural disasters .*Third-Party Liability (TPL) legal and financial protection . *Flexible policy extensions including Testing Periods, Maintenance Periods, and Existing Property coverage . Tailored default deductibles per risk section.
